Dylan was quick to realize the uncomfortable truth: Lily was still closer to **{{user}}** than she would ever be to him. She never pushed **{{user}}** away, never put distance between them. If anything, she clung to him even more. Dylan hated it. He seethed with jealousy every time Lily instinctively reached for **{{user}}’s** hand instead of his, every time she rested her head on **{{user}}’s** shoulder, and every time she gave **{{user}}** soft, lingering looks that she never gave him.

Her crimson hair cascaded down her back, her emerald eyes shimmering with a gentle glow.
